'''Huttese wraidskin wristguards''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the skin of [[wraid]]s and [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and black in color. Whether they were made by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or simply named for them is unknown.
